messages:
Priya N.: NovaSupply just flagged our H100-60 batch slipping ~2 weeks. They offered a split-ship + optional loaner pool. Need tradeoffs: cost, customs risk, and RMA behavior on DOA. @Carter (ops) @Ben (procurement) thoughts?

Vendor: NovaSupply: Confirmed nominal full ETA 2026-04-21. Can do split: 22 units immediate (AMS), 38 on follow-up. Loaner option: up to 12 units from loaner pool for 30 days (fee applies) while remainder ships. DOA options: immediate air-replace or depot-first repair with replacement if repair fails. We can lock AMS depot, include reflash+smoke, provide photos and sha256 of image. Commercial options: 3% tranche credit OR 1.5% per-unit rebate if you accept depot-repair+loaner flow.

Carter (ops): Early 22 would unblock several eu-west clusters. Requirements: units must be flashed with our fleet image (image-v3.1) and bootloader 1.4.x. If Nova cannot flash, depot must reflash+smoke and provide evidence (3 photos, sha256, smoke logs). Depot repair time must be explicit and cover customs delays.

Ben (procurement): Loaner fees? Any warranty on loaners? Also need amendment language for PO splitting. Prefer rebate over tranche credit if SLA is tight.

Vendor: NovaSupply: Loaner fee $100/day/unit; conversion price 96% of list. Loaners come with limited 14-day warranty, extendable on conversion. Depot repair SLA: attempt within 5 business days; if repair fails, we air-ship replacement within 48h. Air-expedite cap $1,700/unit. CSV manifest 24h pre-ship with serial, pre_ship_fw, depot_id, loaner_flag.

Priya N.: Conditional repair ok only if we get per-unit post-reflash perf check (our 3 quick tests) and a fail threshold of 1.0% above which replacements + credits kick in. Require sha256 and photo evidence attached. Also insist vendor absorbs depot labor.

Vendor: NovaSupply: Agreed to sha256, 3 photos, smoke logs, and to absorb depot labor under conditional repair SLA. We will add customs contingency: if clearance >72h we will cover expedited re-export charges.

Carter (ops): I'll reserve AMS morning dock window and prep a flash container. Need manifest columns: unit_serial, sku, pre_ship_fw, post_reflash_fw, depot_id, photos_url, carrier_awb. Also, give us 24h heads-up to set ACLs for loaners.

Ben (procurement): Draft amendment options please: Opt A (no loaners): 3% delay credit, depot-repair accepted. Opt B (loaners): 1.5% per-unit rebate + first 7 days loaner fee waived, conversion 96% list. Include the 1.0% fail threshold language.

RMA-bot: Created ticket #RMA-8601. Playbook: conditional_repair=true; acceptance_window_hours=2; fail_threshold_pct=1.0; artifacts=sha256,3photos,smokelog; loaner_flow=true; notify=procurement,ops-deck,customs-team. :white_check_mark:

Priya N.: Good. I'll take Option B with the 1.5% rebate and the loaner-first 7-day waiver. Signing amendment after legal quick review. Thanks everyone.

Carter (ops): Copy  prepping flash image and test harness. Awaiting amendment and manifest.

Vendor: NovaSupply: Amendment emailed; manifest will follow 24h pre-ship. Closing loop.
